recoveryCards.markdown:
# Calendar and booking details

## Context
Restore consistent appointment details and calendar spacing.

## Implementation

### Phase 1: Shared details
1. Align the service and patient labels.
2. Restore the popover spacing.

### Phase 2: Navigation
1. Preserve the selected appointment when opening its detail page.
2. Keep the patient name below the service title in both views.
3. Verify return navigation restores the previous calendar position.

### Phase 3: Responsive presentation
1. Let the calendar expand without an internal scrollbar.
2. Match the spacing on clinic and professional popovers.
3. Verify dismissal animation and keyboard focus.

## Verification
1. Check clinic and professional calendars.
2. Reload and verify the full plan remains in its card.
